annotations.title: Set the sites a Task can reach

description: Sets the full list of sites a Task's machine may reach (example.com, or *.example.com for its subdomains; up to 20), for steps that have to use a site like a person would. It replaces the list, so read workbench_tasks_get first (allowedSites, and computer.sites for what the plan names) and pass every site to keep. Always waits for approval, and only a workspace admin's approval applies it; for anyone else it says who can. The latest saved version runs with the new list.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

sites.description: Every site the Task may reach.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_tasks_set_sites
title: Set the sites a Task can reach
